The [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Probus Tesla]] owned a [[Color/Legends|crimson]] '''lightsaber''' when he was fourteen. His master [[Kuthara]] once ordered him to go and practice [[Form I/Legends|Shii-Cho]] for six hours with it. When Tesla had completed his Inquisitor training and was barely into his twenties he used the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] again in a [[Duel near Ploughtekal Market|confrontation]] against [[Kajin Savaros]].<ref name="CNIII:POF" />
